title: MIST：面向智能家居的多模态交互式语音工具调用对话助手
summary: MIST是一个合成多轮语音驱动代码生成数据集，用于物联网设备。研究发现开放与封闭权重多模态LLM之间存在显著差距，即使前沿封闭权重模型也有提升空间。发布了MIST及可扩展数据生成框架，以促进对物理世界约束进行推理的混合主动语音助手研究。
summary_en: MIST is a synthetic multi-turn, voice-driven code generation dataset for IoT devices. A significant gap exists between open- and closed-weight multimodal LLMs, with even frontier closed-weight models having headroom. The dataset and an extensible data generation framework are released to facilitate research on mixed-initiative voice assistants reasoning about physical world constraints.
